entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased on [date of purchase]. What seems to be the issue with it?
The pulse sensor is just wildly inaccurate. It's giving me readings that are completely off. I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. I'm happy to help with a return. Could you please confirm the date you would like to return it?
I'm trying to return it *right now*. What's the problem?

Certainly. Upon reviewing our return policy, I see that the return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase. Your purchase was made 15 days ago. Unfortunately, that falls outside of our standard return policy.
What? Are you serious? That's ridiculous! I just bought it. There has to be something you can do. This VeloBand Pulse is defective!

I understand your disappointment. While a full refund isn't possible outside the return window, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. This credit can be used towards any other VeloFit product on our website.
Store credit? Seriously? I don't want store credit! I want my money back. This whole thing is just… ugh!
I completely understand. I know this isn't ideal. Let me see if I can request a policy exception, given the issue you're experiencing with the pulse sensor. One moment, please...

(After a brief pause) Okay, I've spoken with my supervisor. While we typically adhere strictly to the 10-day return window, due to the reported sensor issue, we are willing to make a one-time exception and process a full refund for the VeloBand Pulse. However, in return we ask that you destroy the product. Does that sound good?
Really? You'll do that? Yes! That's all I wanted. Thank you!
You're very welcome! I'll process that refund for you right away. It should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate you going the extra mile.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
